name: Finding Warmth

faq.answer: You gather firewood to keep a welcoming hearth burning. Its keeper has other duties and asks for help collecting fuel.
faq.q: What is the quest Finding Warmth about?

faq.answer: The hearth offers warmth to passing travelers and locals. Firewood keeps it burning while its keeper is busy with other duties.
Wet logs are set aside to dry. The keeper burns seasoned wood right away.
faq.q: What happens to wet firewood brought in?

faq.answer: The host's identity is not given. Their blessing, “Light guide you on your tasks,” suggests reverence for the Holy Light. The host offers an open hearth to warm anyone.
faq.q: What kind of person offers this task?

faq.answer: Yes. After you deliver the firewood, the host says other tasks need an able pair of hands.
faq.q: Are there more tasks after completing Finding Warmth?

faq.answer: Anyone passing through who needs warmth, shelter, or comfort is welcome at the hearth.
faq.q: Who is welcome at this hearth?

sections.body: The hearth welcomes travelers who seek warmth. Its keeper has other duties and cannot gather fuel. Bring firewood to keep the flames alive for those who need shelter and comfort.
sections.title: A Welcoming Hearth

sections.body: Some gathered wood is too damp to burn at once. The keeper sets wet pieces aside to dry and feeds seasoned wood to the fire. With the hearth tended, the keeper turns to other pressing matters.
sections.title: Tending the Fire

summary: A hearth waits for firewood, while its keeper tends to other duties. Gathered logs keep the fire ready to warm anyone who seeks comfort.
